look.summary_zh: 冷色 · 中灰近原值 · 中段拉开
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 127.3/255（变化 -0.2 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.087。中灰红减蓝 -4.0 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #EFD5D7、#CC9088、#794238；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #AE061C、#89CC73、#113EB0。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 127.3/255 (-0.2 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.087; mid-gray red minus blue -4.0 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #EFD5D7, #CC9088, #794238. Red/green/blue swatches: #AE061C, #89CC73, #113EB0.
look.suggested_use_zh: 冷色城市、夜景与科技试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
